_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_as_of: 2026-07-01 · Session 91 (SkyGOAT) · TMC Builder: right-side C-ID coverage roughly DOUBLED + 'X OR Y' course choices now show on the left
_status: Session 91 answered two questions about the TMC Builder from your Saddleback screenshot (lots of blank right-side matches). (1) COVERAGE: the tab was only matching a college's course to a TMC slot when the college itself had recorded the C-ID in COCI — and about a quarter of colleges barely record C-IDs. We folded in the official c-id.net approved-courses list (already in the repo, just unused), which roughly DOUBLED the matches (10,627 → 21,300 college×course C-IDs; ~9,900 courses gained a C-ID). So far fewer blanks now. (2) 'OR' CHOICES: many templates say 'Course X OR Course Y' (pick one) — the builder could already show that, but the data never had it, because the official PDFs hide the 'OR' in a two-column layout that plain text extraction scrambles. We had Claude READ the 45 PDFs visually (with a second pass double-checking each one) to pull out the real OR-groups, and folded 77 of them in — so the left side now shows 'X or Y' and matches either. What it still CAN'T do: if a college simply has no C-ID-approved course for a slot (like Saddleback's Criminal Law), no dataset fills it — that's an honest blank, not a bug.
